## Overview

Orcs are one of the common races of Kythoria, a proud and martial people. They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges. Vorn, the god of war and conquest, claims them as his "conquering children" -- a claim that has made them targets of prejudice in the Last Stand.

---

## Origins

Like all mortal races, Orcs were created by the **Originals** (A, B, C). The public belief that **Vorn** created the Orcs is part of the divine deception to maintain worship.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Vorn** | War & Conquest | Orcs |

Vorn is the god of war and conquest. His church, the **Iron Host**, is a banned organization in Last Stand territories. His claim over the Orc race fuels their discrimination.

---

## Society & Culture

Orc culture follows standard Fifth Edition norms, shaped by a martial tradition, clan-based society, and close ties to the northern frontier and barbarian tribes. Their warriors are formidable, and they are known for their physical strength and endurance.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Half-Orc traits as the baseline for Orc statistics (darkvision, Relentless Endurance, Savage Attacks). Setting-specific modifications to be defined.

---

## Social Standing

Because **Vorn** is one of the three gods publicly blamed for the monster invasion, his worshippers and the race he claims face discrimination:

- Orcs are mistrusted in nearly every settlement
- Their Half-Orc offspring inherit this stigma
- Vorn worship among Orcs must be conducted in secret
- The Iron Host operates underground within Last Stand territory

---

## Notable Individuals

- None documented yet. (The four great barbarian tribes include Orcs, but individual names are not yet defined.)
